title: File:The political raree-show- or a picture of parties and politics, during and at the close of the last session of Parliament, June 1779 (BM 1868,0808.4594).jpg
desc: Twelve views seen in a peep-show, the views being arranged in four rows; the outside of the box or booth is seen on the left, a boy looks through a round hole, the showman points, saying to him, "There you shall see". His words are given at length in the accompanying text (See Curatorial Comment).
